input.prompt: Compute the bulk modulus of the given material by applying small finite deformations and calculating the full elastic constant tensor, followed by the Voigt averaging method. Retrieve the structure of Silicon from the Materials Project database with mp-149 as the Materials Project ID and save it in the LAMMPS data format using 'full' as the atom style. Replicate the unit cell 2 times in each of the x, y, and z directions, use real units, and apply periodic boundary conditions in all directions. Use the ReaxFF potential and include charge equilibration using fix qeq/reaxff. First, relax the simulation box to zero pressure using the box/relax fix and perform energy minimization with a force tolerance of 1e-10, energy tolerance of 0.0, maximum iterations of 100, and maximum evaluations of 1000. Save the relaxed structure. Then, apply small symmetric deformations in each of the six independent strain directions, and after each deformation, perform energy minimization to relax the atomic positions using the same minimization parameters. From the stress response of each deformation, compute the full elastic constant tensor, and calculate the bulk modulus using the Voigt average formula. Report the final value of the bulk modulus in GPa.
